rev.t: Had a very smooth experience purchasing the Sony Theatre bar 6 soundbar from Sony Center HSR. The other stores were quoting it in the same price range but were doing next day delivery. Amazon had the best price but delivery was a week away. …

I had a great experience at the Sony Centre. The staff was very well trained and explained all the features clearly, which really impressed me. They were respectful and attentive throughout the process. …
Theertha was excellent in hearing and recommendations!! All together very good service and quick purchase from centre. Would definitely recommend !!
